# QueroCura

> QueroCura is an Indian healthcare software platform with two connected parts: a free health app for people and families (symptom checker in English and Hindi, medicine reminders, personal health records called CuraVault, family health management, visit preparation) and a hospital management system (HMS) for clinics and hospitals of any size (appointments with real wait times, OPD tokens, emergency triage, beds, operation theatres, pharmacy, billing with UPI, PM-JAY and CGHS, roles, audit logs and AI-assisted imaging). Patients decide what their hospital can see. QueroCura never recommends medicines and is not a diagnosis.

Key facts:
- Website: https://querocura.com . Contact: hello@querocura.com. Founded by Udantika Dhar (CEO) and Saumit Pradhan (CTO). Based in India.
- The health app is free, works in English and Hindi, in any phone or computer browser.
- The hospital management system is for clinics, nursing homes and multi-specialty hospitals, from one site to many branches; QueroCura is onboarding its first hospitals and prices by size.
- Safety: QueroCura never recommends medicines; symptom checks are not a diagnosis; imaging AI drafts are decision support signed off by a clinician.
- Privacy: patients choose what a hospital sees, records are encrypted, and every access is logged.

## For hospitals and clinics

- [A hospital management system that runs every hour of your hospital](https://querocura.com/hospital-management-system/): QueroCura HMS runs appointments, OPD tokens, triage, beds, theatres, pharmacy and billing (UPI, PM-JAY, CGHS) for clinics and hospitals of any size. ABHA ready.
- [Clinic management software for doctors who would rather see patients than paperwork](https://querocura.com/clinic-management-software/): Clinic management software for doctors and small clinics in India: appointments with real wait times, OPD tokens, e-prescriptions, billing with UPI, and practice insights.
- [Doctor appointment booking that shows when patients will really be seen](https://querocura.com/doctor-appointment-booking/): Online doctor appointment booking that shows when you'll really be seen, an OPD token queue and a waiting-room screen. For clinics and hospitals in India.
- [AI-assisted imaging reads that your radiologist stays in charge of](https://querocura.com/ai-medical-imaging/): AI-assisted draft reads for chest X-ray, CT and ECG that your radiologist accepts and signs. Runs on your own server so images never leave the hospital. Decision support.
- [How to choose a hospital management system: a practical checklist](https://querocura.com/guides/how-to-choose-a-hospital-management-system/): A practical checklist for choosing the best hospital management system for your hospital or clinic in India: modules, billing, ABHA, security, setup time and cost.

## For people and families

- [A medicine reminder app that keeps the whole family in the loop](https://querocura.com/medicine-reminder-app/): A free medicine reminder app: dose reminders timed to your prescriptions, a Taken button right on the notification, and alerts to family when a dose is taken. English & Hindi.
- [Manage your family's health together, with everyone's permission](https://querocura.com/family-health-app/): Manage your family's health in one place: connect parents and children, choose what each person can see (medicines, records, vitals), and get instant updates. Free.
- [Your medical reports, in one place, explained in plain language](https://querocura.com/personal-health-records/): CuraVault keeps your reports, prescriptions and scans in one encrypted place, reads them (even handwritten ones) and explains each value in plain language. Free.
- [A symptom checker that asks the questions a doctor would](https://querocura.com/symptom-checker/): Describe how you feel in your own words, in English or Hindi. QueroCura asks the follow-up questions a doctor would and tells you how urgent it is. Never medicine advice.
- [One health app for your symptoms, medicines, records and family](https://querocura.com/health-app/): One free health app for symptom checks in English and Hindi, medicine reminders, personal health records, visit prep and your family's health. Never medicine advice.

## Free calculators

- [BMI calculator with Indian cut-offs](https://querocura.com/calculators/bmi-calculator/): Free BMI calculator with both WHO and the lower Asian-Indian cut-offs (overweight from 23, obese from 25). Enter height and weight; nothing is sent anywhere.
- [Is my blood pressure normal? Check a reading](https://querocura.com/calculators/blood-pressure-checker/): Enter your blood pressure reading to see its category (ISH 2020): normal, high-normal, grade 1 or grade 2 hypertension, and when to get urgent care.
- [HbA1c to average blood sugar](https://querocura.com/calculators/hba1c-to-average-glucose/): Convert an HbA1c result to estimated average glucose in mg/dL and mmol/L, or the other way round, with the normal, prediabetes and diabetes ranges.
- [Pregnancy due date calculator](https://querocura.com/calculators/pregnancy-due-date/): Calculate your estimated due date and how many weeks pregnant you are from the first day of your last period, with your cycle length.
- [Make a printable medicine schedule](https://querocura.com/calculators/medicine-schedule-maker/): Make a printable daily medicine chart for a parent or yourself: medicines, doses and times of day in a clear table. Free, in your browser, nothing is sent anywhere.
- [QTc calculator (four formulas)](https://querocura.com/calculators/qtc-calculator/): Corrected QT interval calculator for clinicians: Bazett, Fridericia, Framingham and Hodges from QT and heart rate, with prolongation thresholds.
- [Bed occupancy rate and length-of-stay calculator](https://querocura.com/calculators/bed-occupancy-rate/): Free hospital KPI calculator: bed occupancy rate, average length of stay (ALOS), bed turnover rate and turnover interval from beds, inpatient days and discharges.
- [OPD capacity and waiting time calculator](https://querocura.com/calculators/opd-capacity-planner/): How many OPD patients can your doctors see per day, and how long will the next patient wait? A free calculator for clinics and hospitals.

## Guides and reference

- [How to reduce OPD waiting time: 8 practical fixes](https://querocura.com/guides/how-to-reduce-opd-waiting-time/): Long OPD queues cost patients and revenue. Eight practical ways Indian clinics and hospitals cut waiting time, from realistic booking to honest queue screens.
- [How to help elderly parents take their medicines on time](https://querocura.com/guides/how-to-remind-elderly-parents-to-take-medicines/): Practical ways to help ageing parents take medicines correctly, especially from another city: a clear list, pill organisers, reminders, and family alerts.
- [EMR vs EHR vs HMS vs PHR: what's the difference?](https://querocura.com/guides/emr-vs-ehr-vs-hms/): Plain-language definitions of EMR, EHR, HMS (HIS) and PHR, how they differ, and how they fit together with ABHA and ABDM in India.
- [How to organise your family's medical records](https://querocura.com/guides/how-to-organise-your-familys-medical-records/): A simple system for keeping your family's reports, prescriptions and scans organised and ready for any doctor's visit or emergency.
- [Healthcare and hospital glossary](https://querocura.com/glossary/): Plain-language definitions of 30 healthcare and hospital terms used in India: OPD, IPD, ABHA, ABDM, PM-JAY, CGHS, NABH, EMR, EHR, ALOS, triage and more.

## About

- [Organised healthcare software, for the people who give care and the people who receive it](https://querocura.com/healthcare-software/): QueroCura is organised healthcare software for India: a hospital management system for providers and a free health app for patients and families, connected by consent.
- [About QueroCura](https://querocura.com/about/): QueroCura builds a hospital management system and a free family health app, connected by patient consent. Founded by Udantika Dhar (CEO) and Saumit Pradhan (CTO).
- [Press kit](https://querocura.com/press/): Facts, boilerplate, founders and contact for journalists and partners writing about QueroCura, Indian healthcare software for hospitals and families.
- [Hospital portal](https://querocura.com/hospital/): sign in or apply to onboard a hospital or clinic
- [For doctors](https://querocura.com/doctor/): practice tools for doctors

## हिन्दी (Hindi)

- [आपकी और आपके परिवार की सेहत, एक ही जगह](https://querocura.com/hi/): हिन्दी में मुफ़्त हेल्थ ऐप: लक्षण जाँच, दवा याद दिलाने वाले रिमाइंडर, मेडिकल रिपोर्ट सँभालना और समझना, और पूरे परिवार की सेहत एक जगह। दवा की सलाह कभी नहीं।
- [दवा याद दिलाने वाला ऐप, जो पूरे परिवार को साथ रखता है](https://querocura.com/hi/medicine-reminder-app/): मुफ़्त दवा रिमाइंडर ऐप: पर्चे के हिसाब से समय पर याद, नोटिफ़िकेशन पर ही "ले ली" बटन, और दवा लेते ही परिवार को सूचना। हिन्दी और अंग्रेज़ी में।
- [पूरे परिवार की सेहत, सबकी अनुमति से](https://querocura.com/hi/family-health-app/): पूरे परिवार की सेहत एक जगह: माता-पिता और बच्चों के खाते जोड़ें, हर व्यक्ति तय करे कि आप क्या देख सकते हैं (दवाएँ, रिपोर्ट, रीडिंग)। मुफ़्त।
- [हिन्दी में लक्षण जाँच, जो डॉक्टर की तरह सवाल पूछती है](https://querocura.com/hi/symptom-checker/): अपने लक्षण हिन्दी में अपने शब्दों में बताइए। QueroCura डॉक्टर की तरह आगे के सवाल पूछता है और बताता है कि मामला कितना ज़रूरी है। दवा की सलाह कभी नहीं।
- [आपकी मेडिकल रिपोर्टें, एक जगह, आसान भाषा में](https://querocura.com/hi/personal-health-records/): CuraVault आपकी रिपोर्ट, पर्चे और स्कैन एक एन्क्रिप्टेड जगह रखता है, उन्हें पढ़ता है (हाथ से लिखे भी) और हर वैल्यू आसान भाषा में समझाता है। मुफ़्त।
